title: Eleven Clauses and One Copy
subtitle: 制度与章程 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 制度与章程（社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：制度与章程（社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：constitution　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 constitution 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my teacher ① lent me a constitution that had eleven clauses underlined, and she said the lending was the whole of the lesson. The ② constitution, meaning the document and not the country, was one copy and stayed that copy; constitution, she said, is the only thing in a drawer that is judged by how often it is taken out.

Every ③ constitution in that cupboard had the same stamp, and the ④ constitution at the end, meaning the one she kept for the debate and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever quoted twice. Constitution, my mother said, is nine parts stamp and one part somebody willing to read it; my teacher said the reading is the part that fills the margin.

My grandfather meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ constitution was the whole of the walking, meaning the health and not the document. The ⑥ constitution, meaning the health and not any of that, is the only thing in a walk that everybody depends on and nobody trains; constitution, he said, is either something you lend or the only word that means both a document and a health. She said the health is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ constitution had become a line in a syllabus, and the syllabus had become an argument about the stamp. The ⑧ constitution of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in March, was one copy and thirty years of reading; constitution, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to quote. He said the quoting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ constitution I remember is the one at the end, which I returned in 1971 and is still described as the most underlined in the school. A ⑩ constitution, my mother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being read; every constitution, she said, is a health that has agreed to look like a document. She said the health was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 宪法（指那份文件本身，与那个国家相对）
C. 固定搭配：lend sb a constitution 借给某人一部宪法（文本）
D. n. 宪法（指那个柜子里每一本）
E. n. 宪法（指末尾那一本）
F. n. 体格；体质（指身体的素质）
G. n. 宪法（指教学大纲里提到的那一部）
H. n. 制度；体制（抽象总称）

items.q: lent me a constitution that had eleven clauses underlined
The constitution, meaning the document and not the country
constitution was the whole of the walking
the constitution had become a line in a syllabus
The constitution of the whole thing
A constitution, my mother said in 1973

answers.why: lend sb a constitution 意为“借给某人一部宪法（文本）”，1957 年老师借给我一部划了十一条款下划线的宪法。
constitution 意为“宪法”，指那份文件本身而不是那个国家，只有一本。
constitution 指那个柜子里每一本宪法，每一本都盖着同样的印章。
constitution 指末尾那一本（她留给辩论赛的那一本），是唯一有人引用过两次的。
constitution 意为“体格、体质”，祖父说体格就是那次步行的全部，指的是身体素质而不是那份文件。
constitution 为另一个义项，指身体的素质而不是那份文件，是步行里人人都依赖、却无人锻炼的东西。
constitution 意为“宪法”，指教学大纲里提到的那一部，到 1965 年这部宪法成了大纲里的一行。
constitution 意为“制度、体制”，老师三月写道，整件事的制度是一本宪法三十年的阅读。
constitution 意为“宪法”，我记得的是末尾那一本，我 1971 年归还，至今仍被说成全校划线最多的。
constitution 为抽象总称，母亲说一部宪法是唯一会因为被阅读而变好的东西。

Every constitution in that cupboard had the same stamp.
The constitution at the end, meaning the one she kept for the debate and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever quoted twice.
